correctness.rationale: For each n≥1, Bell-number coarsening counts identify block count in one round; the strict-predecessor count in the T2 atom class has a unique extremal block-size type Tr for each r≥3, recognized at round two. Counts of Tr strict predecessors at round three recover every binomial moment b_r with explicit correction for reflexive exclusion. Upper-triangular inversion recovers all block multiplicities. Relabelling transitivity proves equality with actual automorphism orbits, and the orbit-stabilizer count gives the stated class cardinalities. Independent exhaustive full-relation refinement runs through n=8 and integer-type inversion through n=30 corroborate only.

value.rationale: The parameter-free three-round uniform recovery statement bridges classical set-partition lattice orbit combinatorics and counting refinement on full directed order structures. Unlike merely naming existing block-size orbits, it explains how a fixed-depth neighbourhood-counting procedure recovers the complete profile for arbitrary Bell-size lattices. The natural underlying lattice, the uniform depth bound, and the exact orbit counts justify value without requiring an identification theorem against external structures. The theorem is explicitly full-order scoped; the bound is not proved optimal.
